title: Clarify where AI, CDSE, LIMR and SGI sit relative to each other
requirements:
- Clarify the relation between AI models and the CDSE
- Present delegation of exact, rule-bound answers to governed services as an architecture-wide safety principle
- Add a schematic or explanation of the relationship
- Record task assignment, status, clinician acceptance and final responsibility across facility, AI service and specialist
- Identify candidate reusable AI capabilities and the criteria for treating them as components, without proposing one national AI platform
- Qualify reproducibility as relative to rule set, reference-data version and time context
- Include governed rule and guideline repositories among the dependencies
